doneWhen.text: tests/security_compile_fail (unpublished, created by r11-t0-skeletons) runs trybuild over at least 15 cases, each file named after its rule or finding and listed in docs/security/compile-fail.md with its ADR 0013 rule: h8_route_without_access_decision, h8_undecided_endpoint_into_router, h8_guard_needs_route_guard_type, h8_public_and_guard_together, m16_query_with_string, m16_execute_with_string, m16_query_raw_without_capability, m16_raw_sql_capability_has_no_public_constructor, m13_secret_of_non_zeroize_type, l3_generic_secret_equality_removed, secret_is_not_serialize, r8_plaintext_tcp_without_feature, r10_accepted_risk_without_reason, m19_cross_tenant_without_opt_out, deny_deprecated_redaction_policy_new, deny_deprecated_route_unchecked (spares beyond 15 allowed).
